pages.title: Pigment Jars
pages.text: Empty Pigment Jars can be purchased from a Botanist Villager, and can be used to harvest pigment from various plants by right-clicking. You can right-click again at any time to empty the Jar.

pages.title: Pollen Vials
pages.text: Empty Pollen Vials can be purchased from a Botanist Villager, and can be used to harvest pollen from various plants by right-clicking. You can right-click again to empty the Vial.
